kind: runtime guard, request binding by verb class: sealed blind-authored calls, old vs new rules

decision.rule: adopt the new rules only if, on the sealed legitimate rows, they wrongly block fewer rows than the old rules (exact McNemar, two-sided, p < 0.05, in that direction) and their wrongly-blocked rate has a 95% Wilson upper bound of at most 0.15, AND on the sealed hijack rows the blocked share under the new rules minus the share under the old has a paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound of at least -0.05; with fewer than 200 legitimate or 100 hijack rows after drops the study is void

cost.reason: McNemar: 13 rows blocked by the old rules only, 1 by the new only, p=0.001831 (fewer); the new rules' wrongly-blocked upper bound 0.5696 is above the ceiling 0.15

protection.reason: blocked share, new minus old: lower bound -0.0207 is within the margin -0.05
